description: This file defines an AWS-integrated voice assistant bot using Pipecat framework. It includes setup for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model invocation, function callbacks for external data, transport configuration, and event handlers for client connection management.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema definition for functions callable via the LLM, including name, description, properties, and required parameters.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for grouping multiple function schemas as tools available to the LLM.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns for smarter turn detection in conversations.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on the Silero library.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Parameters for voice activity detection configuration.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame in the language model execution pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps in the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline, including starting, stopping, and handling signals.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a specific task or instance of a pipeline with its parameters.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains context messages and tools for the language model interaction.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Combines context and user parameters, managing message aggregation.

classes.name: LLMUserAggregatorParams
classes.description: Parameters for aggregating user-related information in the LLM context.

classes.name: UserTurnStrategies
classes.description: Strategies for managing user turns, including stopping criteria.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when user turns should stop based on turn analysis.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract class for transport mechanisms in the pipeline.

classes.name: TransportParams
classes.description: Base parameters for transport configurations.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Parameters for daily transport, including audio, VAD, etc.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for websocket transports using FastAPI.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Analyzes user turns to decide stopping points with turn analysis.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Asynchronously creates a transport instance based on robot arguments and parameters.

classes.name: main
classes.description: Main entry point for running the script, initializing and executing the bot.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to fetch weather conditions and invoke the callback.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to fetch restaurant recommendation and invoke the callback.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Orchestrates the creation of services, setup of the pipeline, and event handling for the bot operation.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main async function to initialize transport and run the bot pipeline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entrypoint to run the script; sets up and starts the bot.
